root_read: Complete candidate and independent full review; six bound artifacts verified and exact checker independently rerun. Accepted BSC001 likelihood source already read and its root receipt validated; historical pending labels retained, superseded by this acceptance.
key_checks: One-sided exclusive event balanced through two actual channel uses; only coarsened transcript is BEC. Each likelihood-test conditional error separately bounded by h^R. Finite same-support channel has bounded ratios. Full-history floor separate from exact-gate comparison.
limits: Constants depend on fixed W. Feasible targets such as Cg+1, not arbitrary tiny constants. Partial-support fixed-R risk exponents not claimed sharp.
